tagline: 禄来中画幅相机，2007 年发布
description: 禄来于2007年推出的中画幅相机。配备Schneider Tele-Xenar 1:4 f=135mm, HFT coating.The lens name was later changed in Tele-Apogon by DHW Fototechnik.。快门速度Copal leafshutter. Speeds 1 to 1/500 sec. and B.。使用12 exposures of 6 x 6 cm on 120 type rollfilm.。感光度25 to 6400 ISO.。

specs.胶片/画幅: 12 exposures of 6 x 6 cm on 120 type rollfilm.
specs.镜头: Schneider Tele-Xenar 1:4 f=135mm, HFT coating.The lens name was later changed in Tele-Apogon by DHW Fototechnik.
specs.快门: Copal leafshutter. Speeds 1 to 1/500 sec. and B.
specs.闪光灯: Accessory shoe with system contacts. X-sync socket.On film flash measurement with a single SI photo element.
specs.英文简介: The Rolleiflex 4,0 FT is a medium format TLR camera manufactured by Rollei and later on by DHW Fototechnik from 2003 till 2014.
